name: inspira-colourful-text
blurb: Characters pulse and shift through a color palette continuously.
description: Renders text with each character animated to cycle through a color array every 5 seconds, with a subtle blur and scale pulse. Non-interactive.
use_when: Decorative headline or accent text that should feel alive without interaction.
avoid_when: Body text or accessibility-critical content — continuous animation is hard to read and respects no motion preferences.
a11y: Renders plain text but runs unguarded continuous animation. No prefers-reduced-motion support.
